caribbean.headline: St. Lucia Sees Rain and 4.5 ft East Swell
caribbean.paragraph: St. Lucia is experiencing east swell-driven seas of 4.5 ft with 6 s periods, east winds near 10 kt and 100% rain probability. I'm watching Roatan where winds increase to 19 kt and could produce choppy conditions for port operations while other Caribbean ports remain under light to moderate trades.

mediterranean.headline: Choppy Seas and Showers for Palma Today
mediterranean.paragraph: Palma de Mallorca is experiencing SSW winds up to 18 kt with seas to 6.0 ft and a 6 s swell, and there is a 38% rain probability. I advise commercial and leisure operators to expect short-period chop and spotty showers while conditions remain below Small Craft Advisory thresholds, with Barcelona seeing lighter winds near 11 kt.
